changelog.message: op created for native Node N-API-backed global mouse telemetry
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Streams high-frequency real-time global mouse telemetry (position, clicks, scrolls) directly using native macOS Node-API bindings without WebSockets.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Enable or disable global mouse telemetry listening.

ports.name: PPS Limit
ports.text: The maximum number of position update packets sent per second.

ports.name: On Move
ports.text: Fires when a mouse movement telemetry event is received.

ports.name: On Click
ports.text: Fires when a mouse button click telemetry event is received.

ports.name: On Scroll
ports.text: Fires when a mouse scroll telemetry event is received.

ports.name: Pos X
ports.text: Absolute X coordinate of the cursor on the primary display.

ports.name: Pos Y
ports.text: Absolute Y coordinate of the cursor on the primary display.

ports.name: Button
ports.text: The mouse button index (e.g., 1 for MB1, 2 for MB2, etc.).

ports.name: Button Is Down
ports.text: True when the mouse button is pressed.

ports.name: Button Is Up
ports.text: True when the mouse button is released.

ports.name: Scroll Delta X
ports.text: Horizontal mouse wheel scroll delta value.

ports.name: Scroll Delta Y
ports.text: Vertical mouse wheel scroll delta value.
